identifier.value: AON M2+ High Temperature Industrial 3D Printer

product.name: AON M2+ High Temperature Industrial 3D Printer
product.description: An industrial 3D printer designed to manufacture full-scale, high-performance parts using high-temperature polymers like PEEK, PEKK, and ULTEM™.

product.name: Hylo™ Additive Manufacturing Platform
product.description: A platform combining physics-based thermal simulation software, hardware automation, and in-process monitoring to produce repeatable, quality-verified 3D printed parts.

product.name: Basis™ Software
product.description: Software that simplifies the additive manufacturing workflow from 3D model to quality-verified parts with optimized print settings.

product.name: Open Materials System
product.description: A system that allows printing with a wide range of polymers and composites without material license fees or hardware upgrades.
